item.title: Trump plans to ease some steel, aluminum tariffs
item.description: Donald Trump plans to scale back select steel and aluminum tariffs amid price concerns, as shares of Nucor and Alcoa fall on report.

item.title: U.S. and Taiwan finalize reciprocal trade agreement
item.description: U.S. and Taiwan finalize a trade deal setting 15% tariffs, boosting U.S. exports and securing major LNG, aircraft and semiconductor commitments.

item.title: Milwaukee suburb approves 210-unit apartment rezoning
item.description: Brookfield Plan Commission approves rezoning for Brookfield Reserve Phase 2, a 210-unit market-rate apartment project replacing office space.

item.title: Housing plan emerges for stalled Milwaukee Sears site
item.description: Developers seek affordable housing tax credits for 46 apartments at Milwaukee’s former Sears site as a city loan remains overdue.

item.title: Senate to hold Fed confirmation hearings for Warsh
item.description: Senate Banking Committee to advance Kevin Warsh’s Fed nomination despite Sen. Thom Tillis’ hold tied to a DOJ probe of Jerome Powell.

item.title: Fed to name former Wall Street lawyer to top bank oversight role
item.description: The Federal Reserve is set to name Randall Guynn as supervision director, marking a shift from career staff as Michelle Bowman advances banking rule reforms.

item.title: U.S. inflation cools in January due to moderation in rent, gas
item.description: U.S. consumer prices rose less than expected in January, but core CPI edged higher, keeping the Federal Reserve cautious on rate cuts.

item.title: Q&A: Forte Real Estate Services COO on office market outlook
item.description: Paul Donovan of Forte Real Estate Services shares insights on office and industrial markets, client strategy and flexible real estate deals.

item.title: Colliers: Negative industrial absorption ‘temporary correction’
item.description: Twin Cities industrial market saw 1.3M square feet of negative absorption in Q4 2025, pushing vacancy to 5.1%, according to Colliers.

item.title: Just Sold: Genesis to move to new location in Brooklyn Park
item.description: Hawkins Inc. and an entity related to Genesis Group Homes buy office warehouse properties in Brooklyn Park and Roseville for a combined $13.67 million.
